lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: NIX, YOU CAN'T LOCK MY GYM BAG IN A VENDING MACHINE [beat] GIVE ME THE CODE OR I'M TEARING THIS WHOLE SCHOOL APART!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s not just a vending machine, Bruno [beat] it’s the new school economy, and your sweaty sneakers are just collateral for my snack empire.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I don't care about your empire [beat] unlock locker forty-two right now or I am going to throw this machine out of a window!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Put that hammer down right now, Bruno [beat] because those machines were installed with my full permission and a signed contract.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: But he's charging us Nix-Coins just to get our own stuff back [beat] how is this even allowed in a public school building?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It’s perfectly legal because you don't buy Nix-Coins with money [beat] you earn them by being a decent human being for once.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I just got a jumbo bag of chips [beat] and all it cost me was five minutes of tutoring a freshman in the library!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: I got a cold soda just for picking up the trash [beat] around the football field, which makes me richer than you'll ever be, Bruno.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: This is a scam [beat] I have zero coins because everyone says I'm a jerk, so I can't even get my shoes back to go home!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That’s the beauty of the system [beat] if you want to eat or participate in sports, you have to stop being the school bully.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Detention rates have dropped eighty percent in just one week [beat] so Nix, I’m making this Snack King position a permanent student government office.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Fine, I'll apologize to the nerds [beat] just give me the code so I can stop walking around the hallways in my socks!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Sorry Bruno, but an apology is only worth half a Nix-Coin [beat] if you want those shoes, you better start scrubbing the cafeteria tables right now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that’s how the school bully became the head janitor's assistant [beat] proving that in Nix’s world, kindness is the only currency that actually matters.
